about_the_game:
On a chill and cozy evening, a puzzle box is all you ever need!

In Follow These Steps you're tasked with building cute objects and scenes out of colorful pieces. Open and empty foil packs, rummage through dozens of pieces, and read step-by-step instructions to complete the puzzle. Build up stacks, then arrange them to reveal the result!

Or ignore all that, and build whatever you can imagine, with a limitless supply of pieces in 12 colors and several styles.

Features

  • Dozens of creative and cute puzzle sets to challenge you!

  • Touch, grab, drag, and drop everything with satisfying animations!

  • No time pressure, no score, no fail state — just you and your leisure time!

  • A freeform creative mode where your imagination is let loose!

  • Share your creations with others to let them follow your steps!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any Linux distribution released after 2022
  • Processor: Any 32-bit CPU with SSE2 instructions
  • Memory: 128 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 70 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Any Linux distribution released after 2022
  • Processor: Any 4-core 64-bit CPU
  • Memory: 256 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full OpenGL 4.6 support
  • Storage: 70 MB available space
